title: Regenerate drifted vector files in one coordinated pass (packet_walkthrough, authenticated_schc_dio, tunnel_authorization, ipv6-addresses, ipv6-icmpv6)
description: Child of wtxl family (1). Inventory on beads-worker-6 (measured 2026-08-30): generate_packet_walkthrough.py --check flags packet_walkthrough.json (CLI test reports it as packets-formats.json + packets-timing.json staleness); generate_authenticated_schc_dio.py --check flags authenticated_schc_dio.json; generate_tunnel_authorization.py --check flags tunnel_authorization.json; generate_ipv6_addresses.py --check flags ipv6-addresses.json; generate_ipv6_icmpv6.py --check flags ipv6-icmpv6.json. Fix: run the five generators without --check (one coordinated pass per wtxl), INSPECT each git diff for sanity (intentional content evolution vs nondeterminism - if timestamps/randomness appear, STOP and file instead), rerun all --check (expect clean), then run the named test suites: python/tests/test_vector_generator_cli.py, python/tests/test_vectors.py (full), python/tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py, python/tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py, test_ipv6_routing_relay_vectors.py::test_committed_icmpv6_vectors_match_stdlib_generator. Note: cross-implementation oracle files - coordinate any consumer-side (Rust/C) expectation changes in the same commit if the regenerated content shifts what they pin.
